feeds.title: Medical News Today » Pancreatic Cancer
feeds.description: Cancer of the pancreas is more common in older people and affects men and women equally. The first noticeable symptoms of pancreatic cancer are often pain in the back or stomach area, unexpected weight loss and jaundice. The three main treatments for pancreatic cancer are surgery, chemotherapy and radiation therapy.
